estimates.rationale: Foundational: establishes the (sku,location) stock schema + repository/service/boundary layers plus list view, file form, and inline optimistic adjust E2E.
Small extension of F1 reusing the same row; adds the (sku,location) uniqueness invariant and a per-location detail view.
First stock-movement flow on top of F1/F2: receipt form with field-level validation, supplier reference, and stock increment against the branch DB.
Second movement flow with the no-overcommit business rule (R2): draw-down plus inline rejection leaving quantity unchanged, verified end to end.
